title: Zesty Shattering Dutch Feta Biryani
description: A festive and aromatic Dutch dish featuring feta, with a shattering crust and a flavorful blend of spices, fermented to perfection in a tandoor clay pot.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the basmati rice, cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted ghee, yogurt, and lemon juice.
Add the ghee mixture to the rice mixture and stir until well combined.
Crumble the feta cheese into the rice mixture and stir gently.
Transfer the rice mixture to the preheated tandoor clay pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and let it cook for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and let it cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and shattering.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
